name: forge-github
description: GitHub as the forge: lands verified work by push or by pull request, opens and finds pull requests, publishes repositories.

api.description: The REST API base (GitHub Enterprise: https://ghe.example.com/api/v3)

token.description: A token with repo scope. A secret reference to a variable of its own (capcomd refuses GITHUB_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN, its own, to a plugin that is not built in): {"$secret": "env:FORGE_GITHUB_TOKEN"}. Unset: the plugin asks `gh auth token`

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a pull request to become mergeable
